lines.zh: 马蹄踏在落叶上，我端坐不动。
lines.en: Hooves trample fallen leaves and I sit perfectly still.

lines.zh: 我骑马走过田埂，瓜藤被踩断。
lines.en: I ride the field ridge and the pumpkin vines snap.

lines.zh: 马走一步，我的南瓜头点一下。
lines.en: The horse takes a step and my pumpkin head nods.

lines.zh: 南瓜头很重，马背往下沉。
lines.en: My pumpkin head is heavy and the horse's back sags.

lines.zh: 我沿着蜡烛摆的圈子走。
lines.en: I walk along the circle the candles mark.

lines.zh: 我的脸在夜里很显眼。
lines.en: My face is hard to miss in the night.

lines.zh: 走过村口，狗都不敢叫。
lines.en: I pass the village gate and even the dogs stay quiet.

lines.zh: 马鼻喷出白气，我的烛火也晃。
lines.en: The horse snorts white breath and my candle wavers.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走，让马蹄声先到。
lines.en: I walk slowly so the hoofbeats arrive before me.

lines.zh: 我绕着自己的召唤圈走了一圈。
lines.en: I ride once around the circle that summoned me.

lines.zh: 我坐在马背上等，等到霜落下来。
lines.en: I wait on horseback until the frost comes down.

lines.zh: 十月二十五日之后，我才有力气。
lines.en: Only after October the twenty-fifth do I have strength.

lines.zh: 我数着圈里的蜡烛，一根根看。
lines.en: I count the candles in the circle, one by one.

lines.zh: 马低头吃草，我的头一动不动。
lines.en: The horse grazes and my head does not move.

lines.zh: 我等着有人来砸那个南瓜。
lines.en: I wait for someone to smash that pumpkin.

lines.zh: 夜风穿过我的嘴，火苗歪了。
lines.en: Night wind passes through my mouth and the flame leans.

lines.zh: 我的三个形态在体内排队。
lines.en: My three forms queue up inside me.

lines.zh: 马打了个响鼻，算是回答我。
lines.en: The horse snorts, which counts as an answer.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有人在拆南瓜灯。
lines.en: I hear someone far off taking apart a jack-o'-lantern.

lines.zh: 万圣节的夜太短，我舍不得动。
lines.en: Halloween night is short and I begrudge every move.

lines.zh: 缰绳在我手里，手握不住。
lines.en: The reins are in my hand, and my hand cannot close.

lines.zh: 我盯着自己的影子，它比我像骑士。
lines.en: I watch my shadow; it looks more like a knight than I do.

lines.zh: 蜡烛烧短一寸，我就醒一分。
lines.en: Each inch of candle burned wakes a little more of me.

lines.zh: 我等着钟声，它每年都迟到。
lines.en: I wait for the bell, which is late every year.

lines.zh: 盔甲里的草梗硌得我难受。
lines.en: The straw inside my armor itches.

lines.zh: 我把剑横在鞍上，剑柄冰凉。
lines.en: I lay my sword across the saddle; the hilt is cold.

lines.zh: 我把南瓜脸转向你，眼窝里全是火。
lines.en: I turn my pumpkin face on you, fire filling my eyeholes.

lines.zh: 你看我的脸，我的脸也看着你。
lines.en: You look at my face, and my face looks back.

lines.zh: 你举剑的样子，像个来赴约的人。
lines.en: You raise your sword like someone keeping an appointment.

lines.zh: 我低头，马蹄在你面前停住。
lines.en: I lower my head and the hooves stop before you.

lines.zh: 你的火把照出我刻的牙。
lines.en: Your torch lights up the teeth carved in me.

lines.zh: 我们隔着一圈蜡烛对视。
lines.en: We stare at each other across a ring of candles.

lines.zh: 我记住你的盔甲颜色了。
lines.en: I have noted the colour of your armour.

lines.zh: 你后退半步，我往前半步。
lines.en: You step back half a pace; I step forward half a pace.

lines.zh: 你看我，像看一盏会走路的灯。
lines.en: You look at me like a lantern that learned to walk.

lines.zh: 我歪头，南瓜里的烛火跟着斜。
lines.en: I tilt my head and the candle inside tilts with it.

lines.zh: 你数我有几把武器，我只带一把。
lines.en: You count my weapons; I carry only one.

lines.zh: 我的目光落在你的马上，它比你慌。
lines.en: My gaze falls on your horse, which panics more than you.

lines.zh: 南瓜壳裂了，火从缺口冒出来。
lines.en: My shell cracks and fire leaks from the gap.

lines.zh: 这一剑让我从马背上滑下来。
lines.en: That blow slides me down from the saddle.

lines.zh: 我的脸碎了一半，爵士还在。
lines.en: Half my face is gone and the knight remains.

lines.zh: 疼，但我有三个形态可以换。
lines.en: It hurts, but I have three forms to change into.

lines.zh: 你砍中南瓜蒂，那是我最薄的地方。
lines.en: You hit my stem, the thinnest part of me.

lines.zh: 我的马嘶了一声，比我先叫。
lines.en: My horse neighs before I make a sound.

lines.zh: 伤口里没有血，只有瓜瓤和火。
lines.en: No blood in the wound, only flesh and fire.

lines.zh: 退半步，重新把剑举起来。
lines.en: Half a step back, then the sword comes up again.

lines.zh: 这一下让我换了副面孔。
lines.en: That blow made me change faces.

lines.zh: 我的南瓜头在晃，火却没灭。
lines.en: My pumpkin head rocks, but the fire stays lit.

lines.zh: 南瓜、糖果、蜡烛，我一样都不要。
lines.en: Pumpkins, sweets, candles: I want none of them.

lines.zh: 你举着糖，我举着剑。
lines.en: You hold up sweets; I hold up a sword.

lines.zh: 万圣节的糖是给孩子的，不是给我。
lines.en: Halloween sweets are for children, not for me.

lines.zh: 别拿南瓜灯哄我，我头上就有一个。
lines.en: Do not bribe me with a jack-o'-lantern; I wear one.

lines.zh: 我只要一场像样的决斗。
lines.en: All I want is a proper duel.

lines.zh: 我闻到的只有蜡烛和铁。
lines.en: All I smell is candle wax and iron.

lines.zh: 你把糖放在地上，马蹄踩了过去。
lines.en: You set sweets on the ground and the hooves trample them.

lines.zh: 我不吃，我只在十月的夜里走动。
lines.en: I do not eat; I only walk the October nights.

lines.zh: 你的诱饵太小，配不上小 Boss。
lines.en: Your bait is too small for a mini boss.

lines.zh: 蜡烛比糖果有用，能把我叫醒。
lines.en: Candles are more useful than sweets; they wake me.

lines.zh: 马撞上你，你退了三步。
lines.en: The horse hits you and you retreat three steps.

lines.zh: 我的南瓜头磕在门框上，裂了缝。
lines.en: My pumpkin head strikes the door frame and cracks.

lines.zh: 你别碰马，它比我还急。
lines.en: Do not touch the horse; it is quicker to anger than I am.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，蜡烛倒了一地。
lines.en: We collide and candles fall all over the ground.

lines.zh: 我的马身擦过你的盾，火星四溅。
lines.en: My horse scrapes your shield and sparks fly.

lines.zh: 你顶住马头，马蹄在原地刨土。
lines.en: You push against the horse's head as its hooves tear the dirt.

lines.zh: 碰撞让我从马背上晃了一下。
lines.en: The impact rocks me in the saddle.

lines.zh: 南瓜壳撞碎了半块，瓤挂在我脸上。
lines.en: Half my shell shatters and flesh hangs on my face.

lines.zh: 你挤过来，缰绳缠住了你的剑。
lines.en: You push past and the reins tangle around your sword.

lines.zh: 马受惊后退，把我的头甩歪了。
lines.en: The horse shies backward and throws my head askew.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣是这匹马，别的都不算。
lines.en: My companion is this horse; nothing else counts.

lines.zh: 万圣节只有一夜，来不及找谁。
lines.en: Halloween is one night; there is no time to court anyone.

lines.zh: 我一年只醒十天，谁会等我。
lines.en: I wake ten days a year; who would wait for me?

lines.zh: 南瓜地里没有第二个戴头盔的。
lines.en: There is no second helmeted thing in the pumpkin field.

lines.zh: 我试过和稻草人说话，它太安静。
lines.en: I tried talking to the scarecrow; it is too quiet.

lines.zh: 我的马老了，我也一年比一年空。
lines.en: My horse grows old and I grow emptier each year.

lines.zh: 我的誓言写在南瓜皮上，会烂。
lines.en: My vows are written on pumpkin skin, and they rot.

lines.zh: 十月的夜很长，我一个人也够。
lines.en: October nights are long, and one is enough for me.

lines.zh: 同类？这世上只有我这一个爵士。
lines.en: My kind? There is only one knight of my name.

lines.zh: 我把马鬃梳好，就当是打扮了。
lines.en: I comb the horse's mane and call that dressing up.

lines.zh: 我弯腰去捡蜡烛，南瓜头差点掉了。
lines.en: I bend for a candle and my pumpkin head nearly falls off.

lines.zh: 地上有块南瓜皮，我收进怀里。
lines.en: A piece of pumpkin skin lies there; I tuck it away.

lines.zh: 马蹄踩碎了一个瓜，我没捡。
lines.en: A hoof crushes a pumpkin, and I leave it.

lines.zh: 我捡起掉落的缰绳，重新握紧。
lines.en: I pick up the fallen reins and grip them again.

lines.zh: 剑掉了我会捡，别的都不重要。
lines.en: If my sword drops I retrieve it; nothing else matters.

lines.zh: 你把东西丢在我脚边，我没低头。
lines.en: You drop something at my feet and I do not look down.

lines.zh: 我拾起一根烧完的烛芯，收好。
lines.en: I pick up a burnt wick and keep it.

lines.zh: 太重的东西我不捡，马会累。
lines.en: I leave heavy things; the horse would tire.

lines.zh: 我捡起自己的半块脸，按回去。
lines.en: I pick up half my face and press it back on.

lines.zh: 地上的糖纸被风吹走，我没追。
lines.en: Wind takes the sweet wrapper and I do not chase it.

lines.zh: 你踏进蜡烛圈，我就知道该起身了。
lines.en: You step inside the candle ring and I know to rise.

lines.zh: 马蹄声停了，因为我看中了你。
lines.en: The hoofbeats stop because I have chosen you.

lines.zh: 你碰了那个南瓜，我立刻转身。
lines.en: You touch that pumpkin and I turn at once.

lines.zh: 十月末的夜里，活人只有一个。
lines.en: On a late October night there is only one living soul.

lines.zh: 你的火把太亮，正好当靶子。
lines.en: Your torch is too bright, which makes a fine target.

lines.zh: 我压低南瓜头，马先冲了出去。
lines.en: I lower my pumpkin head and the horse charges first.

lines.zh: 我挑你，因为你是唯一站着的。
lines.en: I pick you because you are the only one still standing.

lines.zh: 你拔剑的声音，我听得清清楚楚。
lines.en: I hear your sword leaving its sheath quite clearly.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，马就知道要冲谁。
lines.en: I raise my hand and the horse knows whom to charge.

lines.zh: 这一夜我只认一个对手。
lines.en: Tonight I acknowledge only one opponent.

lines.zh: 你退到蜡烛外面，我照样追。
lines.en: You retreat beyond the candles and I still give chase.

lines.zh: 我的第二个形态已经在皮下面动。
lines.en: My second form is already stirring under the skin.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁，也有胆，够格。
lines.en: You carry iron and nerve; you will do.

lines.zh: 爵士的规矩：先看对手，再动手。
lines.en: A knight's rule: size up the opponent, then strike.

lines.zh: 你举着南瓜灯，那就是给我的信号。
lines.en: You carry a jack-o'-lantern; that is my signal.

lines.zh: 风向变了，你的味道朝我飘来。
lines.en: The wind shifts, and your scent drifts to me.

lines.zh: 你踩断的枯枝，比喊叫更清楚。
lines.en: The twig you snapped tells me more than a shout.

lines.zh: 你家门口的稻草人，长得很像你。
lines.en: The scarecrow by your door looks a lot like you.

lines.zh: 马蹄追着你的脚步，一步不落。
lines.en: Hooves chase your footsteps and never fall behind.

lines.zh: 你拐进树林，我连树一起撞。
lines.en: You turn into the woods and I crash through the trees.

lines.zh: 我从马背上俯身，剑尖对着你。
lines.en: I lean from the saddle with my sword point on you.

lines.zh: 蜡烛的火在我身后拖成一条线。
lines.en: The candle flames trail behind me in a line.

lines.zh: 你跑得比马慢，这是你的问题。
lines.en: You run slower than a horse; that is your problem.

lines.zh: 我换了个姿势，第三个形态快到了。
lines.en: I shift my stance; the third form is near.

lines.zh: 我的南瓜脸裂开，露出里面的火。
lines.en: My pumpkin face splits and the fire inside shows.

lines.zh: 你听见马蹄，就说明我近了。
lines.en: If you hear hooves, I am close.

lines.zh: 我不喊，马蹄声就是我的战吼。
lines.en: I do not shout; the hoofbeats are my war cry.

lines.zh: 你翻墙，我让马绕到门口。
lines.en: You climb the wall and I ride the horse around to the door.

lines.zh: 我的马蹄，踩在落叶上。
lines.en: My horse's hooves crunch on the leaves.

lines.zh: 我把你逼向蜡烛圈的中心。
lines.en: I drive you toward the centre of the candle ring.

lines.zh: 你回头看，我的剑已经抬起来了。
lines.en: You look back and my sword is already raised.

lines.zh: 别指望天亮，这一夜还长。
lines.en: Do not count on dawn; this night is long.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，让马再快一点。
lines.en: I crouch lower and let the horse run faster.

lines.zh: 你躲进稻草堆，草在抖。
lines.en: You hide in the straw, and the straw trembles.

lines.zh: 我的剑尖一直对着你的背。
lines.en: My blade tip stays aimed at your back.

lines.zh: 你绕着火堆跑，我不会绕。
lines.en: You circle the bonfire; I do not.

lines.zh: 马鼻子里喷出的白气，你也看得见。
lines.en: You can see the white breath from my horse's nostrils.

lines.zh: 我抬起南瓜头，火光从眼窝漏出来。
lines.en: I lift my pumpkin head, and firelight leaks from the eyes.

lines.zh: 我从马背上劈下来，力道全在落点。
lines.en: I cut down from the saddle, all my weight in the strike.

lines.zh: 剑砍在你的盾上，火星落进草里。
lines.en: My sword hits your shield and sparks fall into the grass.

lines.zh: 马蹄踏住你的脚，我的剑随后到。
lines.en: A hoof pins your foot and my sword follows.

lines.zh: 这一击带着马冲的劲，你退了很远。
lines.en: The charge carries the blow and you fly far back.

lines.zh: 我的南瓜头撞在你脸上，很硬。
lines.en: My pumpkin head strikes your face, and it is hard.

lines.zh: 你挡住第一下，第二下从侧面来。
lines.en: You block the first; the second comes from the side.

lines.zh: 剑锋擦过你的肩，夜里血是黑的。
lines.en: My blade grazes your shoulder and the blood looks black.

lines.zh: 我砍空了，剑扎进土里半尺。
lines.en: I miss and the sword sinks half a foot into soil.

lines.zh: 你砍我的马，我就先砍你的手。
lines.en: You cut my horse, so I cut your hand first.

lines.zh: 南瓜裂开时，火从缝里喷出来。
lines.en: When the pumpkin splits, fire jets from the seams.

lines.zh: 我把你按在蜡烛圈里打。
lines.en: I pin you inside the candle ring and strike.

lines.zh: 这一剑下去，我的手臂也震麻了。
lines.en: The blow numbs my own arm as well.

lines.zh: 你退到马腿边，那是最糟的位置。
lines.en: You back against the horse's legs, the worst place to be.

lines.zh: 爵士出手只有一次机会，你躲过了。
lines.en: A knight gets one opening, and you dodged it.

lines.zh: 十月二十五日，我从南瓜里坐起来。
lines.en: On October twenty-fifth I sit up inside a pumpkin.

lines.zh: 有人砸碎了蜡烛环绕的南瓜，我来了。
lines.en: Someone smashed the candle-ringed pumpkin and here I am.

lines.zh: 万圣节的夜一开，马蹄就踏进村子。
lines.en: Halloween night begins and hooves enter the village.

lines.zh: 烛火同时亮起，我的脸成形了。
lines.en: The candles light at once and my face takes shape.

lines.zh: 我从瓜瓤里抽出剑，瓜皮还挂着。
lines.en: I draw my sword from the flesh with rind still clinging.

lines.zh: 这一年只有十天属于我。
lines.en: Only ten days of this year belong to me.

lines.zh: 南瓜裂开的声音，就是我的号角。
lines.en: The sound of a pumpkin splitting is my horn.

lines.zh: 蜡烛围成的圈里，我起身行礼。
lines.en: Inside the ring of candles I rise and bow.

lines.zh: 我从土里升起，马蹄先落在石板上。
lines.en: I rise from the soil and the hooves land on stone first.

lines.zh: 夜风把我的披风吹开，我睁眼。
lines.en: Night wind opens my cloak and I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 小 Boss 不从门进来，我从南瓜里来。
lines.en: A mini boss does not use doors; I come from a pumpkin.

lines.zh: 十月末的第一声雷，把我叫醒。
lines.en: The first thunder of late October wakes me.

lines.zh: 我的三个形态从出生起就排好了。
lines.en: My three forms were set in order at birth.

lines.zh: 蜡烛灭了一根，我的眼窝就亮一点。
lines.en: A candle goes out and my eyeholes brighten.

lines.zh: 今年的霜落得早，我醒得也早。
lines.en: The frost came early this year, so I woke early.

lines.zh: 村口的南瓜全亮了，我在其中。
lines.en: Every pumpkin at the village gate is lit, and I am among them.

lines.zh: 有人把蜡烛摆错方向，我照样出来。
lines.en: Someone set the candles the wrong way, but I came out anyway.

lines.zh: 我的马蹄踏碎了一地瓜皮。
lines.en: My horse's hooves shatter pumpkin rinds across the ground.

lines.zh: 守夜的孩子扔下灯笼就跑了。
lines.en: The child on watch drops the lantern and runs.

lines.zh: 第一面窗亮起来时，我到门口了。
lines.en: When the first window lights up, I am already at the door.

lines.zh: 火对我没用，我本来就在烧。
lines.en: Fire does nothing; I am already burning.

lines.zh: 从马上摔下来，瓜壳磕掉一块。
lines.en: Thrown from the horse, I knock a piece off my shell.

lines.zh: 水浇进南瓜里，火苗矮了一截。
lines.en: Water pours into the pumpkin and the flame shrinks.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀翻马蹄，我从半空落地。
lines.en: The blast flips the hooves up and I drop from midair.

lines.zh: 箭插在瓜皮上，像给我的帽子加了羽毛。
lines.en: An arrow in my rind looks like a feather in my hat.

lines.zh: 魔法钻进瓜壳，烛火变成紫色。
lines.en: Magic seeps into my shell and the flame turns purple.

lines.zh: 我十年没吃东西，也不觉得饿。
lines.en: Ten years without food and I feel no hunger.

lines.zh: 雷打中南瓜蒂，我的脸烧黑了半边。
lines.en: Lightning hits my stem and half my face burns black.

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，我的马蹄踩不到东西。
lines.en: In the void my hooves find nothing to stand on.
